nom: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle Vital Calming Spray Serum

avis.texte: This is an interesting product, something new that I have not tried before. It is a very thin, moisturizing serum that is delivered with a very fine spray mist. The instructions say not to breathe in while spraying the serum on the face, which I agree with. Even with holding my breath while spraying, and for several seconds afterwards, the first breath I take after, causes me to cough, which is why I deducted 1 star. The actual product itself is an extremely fine mist; it almost feels like nothing is spraying on your face at first, but once sprayed and patted into the skin, it leaves a nice feeling of hydration and a healthy, moisturized glow. The scent is a very light floral, almost "expensive skin care" scent however, that is probably what causes me to cough after spraying it. I will enjoy using it while I have it, but I probably wouldn't purchase it again.
My skin loves this! I feel more hydrated and refreshed when I add this to my routine. It feels like luxury and I look forward to it every day (:

Let me start with the things I liked about this product.. I liked the smell, it's a nice floral smell. I liked how light it was, and how it melted into my skin with ease. I liked how it didn't make my skin too oily, and layed great under makeup. My only real complaint is that.. it didn't outshine the competitors at all. The package was just okay, and the quality of the product worked just as well as similar products for half the price. It needs a little more.. pizzazz to get that last star from me. Other than that, I really enjoyed it.

I'm 47, and I've tried a lot of skincare over the years, but I have to say, the d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum has genuinely surprised me in the best way. My skin has been feeling drier and a bit dull lately, especially with changing seasons, and I wanted something easy to use that could give me a boost throughout the day. This spray has become such a staple for me. It's incredibly lightweight, absorbs quickly, and gives my skin an instant glow without feeling greasy or heavy. After a few weeks of using it consistently, I noticed my skin looked more hydrated, smoother, and healthier overall. Even some of those fine lines seemed less noticeable, which at my age is definitely a win! I also love that I can use it over makeup for a quick refresh. It leaves my skin looking dewy and revived instead of tired. The fine mist feels so refreshing. It's one of those little daily moments that feels like self-care. If you're in your 40s like me and looking for something simple but effective to add hydration and radiance, I'd absolutely recommend giving this a try. It's made a real difference for my skin.

The d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum has become one of those products I can't imagine being without. The mist is incredibly fine, the scent is subtle, and the formula feels instantly refreshing. What surprised me most is how soothing it is during my hot flashes — when my face suddenly feels overheated or irritated, a quick spritz calms everything down within seconds. It leaves my skin looking hydrated, dewy, and more balanced without ever feeling greasy. This spray has officially earned a permanent spot in my bag.

I got a sample of d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum to try. I usually do it at night before I go to sleep. My skin feels really fresh and calming and have a good night sleep. It's very easy to use. I just need to shake it 5 times and spray about 3 times. I

I use the d'Alba white Truffle vital spray serum after cleansing and it instantly takes my skin from dull to dewy. Application is easy just shake and spray. There is a slight pleasant scent that dissipates quickly. It could replace a toner. I received this for free in exchange for an honest review.

avis.titre: Gentle Spray Serum for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: This spray serum smells nice and feels great on my skin. It isn't super hydrating, but it also doesn't dry out my skin. It also doesn't cause breakouts or irritate my skin further. Overall, a great product!

This setting spray has become a staple in my routine. The mist is ultra-fine, feels light on my skin, and never leaves behind a sticky or heavy feeling. It gives my makeup a smoother, more natural finish while adding a healthy glow that looks fresh instead of greasy. I also love how well it helps my makeup wear throughout the day without making my skin look chalky or flat. The scent is soft and pleasant, which makes using it feel even more luxe. Overall, it feels like a high-quality product that actually delivers, and I'd definitely recommend it.

avis.titre: I've added to my daily routine!

I feel it makes my skin glow & look younger in my opinion! I've actually already ordered my next bottle! I'm 46 & basically wear no makeup, only mascara & no one believes I'm 46, people always think I'm in my late 20's or 30's🙌🏽 Try it, it's affordable & worth it!
I enjoyed this product it's not something I would consider life changing but I do enjoy using it as a last extra special step to my skincare routine.

I have been using it for a few weeks and my skin has never looked better! I have dewy smooth skin. I definitely recommend trying D'Alba skincare. I also use the pink tone sunscreen and love it.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again

If you're dealing with any redness or just feel a bit dehydrated, it's a solid pick-me-up that actually does what it promises.

I didn't love this product. This is my second time trying something from d'alba and it just does not seem to agree with my skin. I have somewhat oily skin, but not super oily. However, the two things I've tried from them have made my skin so oily and greasy. I think this would work a lot better for dry skin!

I like the product, it definitely makes my skin feel more soft and hydrated. It's not a holy grail for me, but it's still nice to have in rotation. I prefer to use it as a mid day spritz to rehydrate.
This serum has left me with glass like skin. Formula is very light and does not leave you greasy! Would definitely recommend.
The smell is subtle. The effect is amazing. This has the same effect as luxury brand. There's literally truffle inside giving you that luxurious feel.

avis.titre: Glowy Finish but Needs Better Texture
avis.texte: **Title: Glowy Finish but Needs Better Texture** I really enjoyed trying the d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum and can definitely see why it's so popular. It gives my skin a nice, healthy glow and feels refreshing when sprayed on. It also layers well over makeup for a quick hydration boost during the day, which I love. The only downside for me is the texture—it feels a little sticky on the skin, especially if I use more than a light mist. I also noticed that it separates very quickly, so you have to shake it well every time, which can be a bit inconvenient when you're in a rush. Overall, it's a good product that delivers on hydration and glow, but the formula could use a little improvement. I'm giving it 4 stars because of that. *I received this product for free to try.*

The d'Alba spray serum is incredibly refreshing right after face cleansing and makes the face seem so hydrated and smooth. The spray nozzle is wonderful and sprays in a mist equally on the skin without making it seem too dense at specific part.

I've had a chance to use this both day and night for a few weeks now and it's safe to say I have a new favorite part of my skincare routine. It's so easy to spray it on after toner. It's lightweight but hydrating at the same time. There is a light fragrance so I would not recommend to people who are sensitive to fragrances. If you've very dry skin you may need to still use a more hydrating moisturizer but I pair it with a lightweight moisturizer without issues.

Went in with low expectations but it noticeably improved how my skin looks almost immediately. Lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any greasy feel. An easy addition that feels elevated without adding any real effort to your routine.

I have redness around my nose from retinol usage and this definitely helped soothe my redness and brought some hydration to my skin. I wouldn't say it changed my skin jn any major way but it does soothe redness and irritated skin.

I've been using the d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum for a few weeks now, and it has honestly become one of those products I reach for multiple times a day. What I love most is how lightweight yet hydrating it feels. The mist is super fine and evenly sprays on the skin without leaving any sticky or greasy residue. I usually use it right after cleansing and sometimes even over makeup, and it instantly gives my skin a fresh, dewy glow. It's especially great on days when my skin feels dry or dull—just a couple of sprays and my face looks more radiant and refreshed. I've also noticed that it helps calm slight redness and makes my skin feel smoother overall, which aligns with its calming and hydration benefits. Another thing I enjoy is how convenient it is. It works as a toner, serum, and mist all in one, so it's perfect for quick skincare routines or mid-day touch-ups. The only minor downside for me is that the fragrance is a bit noticeable at first, but it fades quickly and doesn't irritate my skin. Overall, I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for an easy, glow-boosting hydration product, especially if you like that glass-skin look without heavy layers. It feels luxurious but still practical for everyday use.

I wasn't sure at first, but I ended up really liking this spray. It's super easy to use and feels nice and hydrating without messing up makeup. It gives a subtle glow—not too shiny. I reach for it during the day when my skin feels dry or dull.
I like this serum and while it makes my skin feel good, the real prize is how lovely it smells.
The mist is amazing after you've put on makeup! It's beautiful, glowy texture!

d'Alba's White Truffle Vital Spray Serum provides instant relief to my skin. My skin felt hydrated, refreshed, and instantly soothing. I like that it is a spritz bottle for the perfect amount. This d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum is very lightweight and refreshing. I like to use this spray whenever the occasion calls for some extra hydration. Using it when I need a quick refresh during the day also gives me a lovely dewy glow without looking 'sweaty' or in need of a blot. The formula isn't tacky, the mist is super light and airy, and the scent while a bit strong initially does go away after a bit of time. I absolutely love the d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum! I've tried quite a few facial mists and hydrating serums, but this one truly stands out. One of the biggest benefits is how versatile it is—I use it before makeup for hydration, after makeup to set everything with a natural glow, and even throughout the day as a quick skin pick-me-up. It instantly makes my skin look healthier and more radiant, and over time I've noticed my skin feels softer and more balanced overall. I would absolutely buy this product again—it's become a staple in my routine. And yes, I've already recommended it to friends and family because it's just that good. If you're looking for an easy way to boost hydration and glow, this is 100% worth it!

Product feels great on the skin. Very refreshing and hydrates my skin very well before I apply my moisturizer in the morning. I was expecting the oil in the spray to break me out, but so far so good. Also gives a healthy glow.

I really enjoyed this product. I like the scent and the way it made my face feel in look after being sprayed. It's easy to use and it leaves your skin looking and feeling great. I definitely recommend it.

I like to use this serum spray in the morning, right after I wash my face. It is soothing, feels amazing, and really sets the stage for the rest of my morning skincare. If is light, not a heavy scent, and pleasant feel.

It can be used as a toner, serum, setting spray or throughout the day refresher, so it's really handy to keep one on the road.

I have combo skin and I like using this spray throughout the day to freshen up my face. Works well on top of make up. There's a layer of oil on top so you should shake it before spraying. It smells herbal-y but I didn't mind the scent.

This serum is lightweight and gives an instant glow and hydration. The bottle packaging is made up of thick glass and it sprays evenly on the face. It has a floral smell which could be overwhelming for some. I used it after washing my face and it immediately hydrates the skin adding the glow.

avis.titre: It feels like heaven, definitely recommend!!!

First off, I have been wanting to try this so I was happy to receive a sample to try out. It smells divine!!! My skin feels hydrated and refreshed. My makeup looks better when I use this product. Definitely worth the hype!

I am glad i got a chance to try this serum. First time to try this brand and it works very well. Precious ingredients, pleasant scent, easy to apply format and immediate visible results. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: My 5 star rating for this spray serum
avis.texte: Texture: d'Alba First Spray Serum has a very fine, lightweight mist that feels refreshing on the skin. The serum absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy, making it perfect to use before makeup or throughout the day for extra hydration. Highlight: I absolutely love, love this product. It instantly makes my skin look dewy, hydrated, and healthy. The blend of serum and oil gives a natural glow while keeping the skin moisturized and smooth. It's super convenient to spray anytime when my skin feels dry or dull. Not-so-like: The only small downside is that it's easy to use a lot because the mist feels so nice, so the bottle can run out quickly if you use it often. Verdict: A luxurious, glow-boosting mist that hydrates, refreshes, and gives your skin a radiant finish anytime during the day. Perfect if you love that dewy "glass skin" look. ✨

I had heard so much about this product that I thought it was just a hype. But I am shocked at how great this actually is. I spray it before I apply my makeup and during the day when I feel I need a skin refresh. Gives the most gorgeous healthy glow on the skin. It absorbs into the skin in seconds and doesn't feel heavy.. and leaves my skin with a soft glowy look. Love this and it is now a staple in my routine!

I try so many incredible products that it's honestly rare for one to become an immediate obsession, but d'Alba Piedmont's White Truffle Vital Spray Serum was truly love at first sight. This luxurious serum mist instantly refreshes and hydrates, leaving skin radiant and dewy. Infused with d'Alba's signature white truffle extract from Piedmont, it gives skin that healthy, luminous look. The ultra-fine spray is lightweight, nourishing, and perfect for a quick revitalizing boost throughout the day, and even over makeup for that extra glow. What I love most is the intoxicating floral scent that invigorates your senses. Safe to say, this is a love affair I see lasting a very long time!

avis.titre: Good hydration in an easy spray
avis.texte: I've been using this spray for about three weeks and I really like it. It makes my dry, mature skin feel so soft, and the scent is really pleasant. I haven't seen major visual changes yet, but the softening and hydrating feel are definitely there and I've used a lot of expensive hydrating products. You do have to hold your breath when you spray it because the mist is easy to inhale. Other than that, it's a great boost my skin really enjoys. Make sure you shake it well before using. I also love that it's a spray because it hits every spot on my face so easily. It's earned a spot in my routine because my skin genuinely enjoys the boost.

I've tried d'Alba mists before, but this White Truffle Vital Spray is by far my favorite. The scent is absolutely amazing it is very light, luxurious, and not overpowering at all! I love that it sprays on so nicely and feels really refreshing without being sticky. My skin feels hydrated and looks brighter after using it, and it layers nicely over makeup and I will be keeping this inside of my purse to use often.

avis.titre: This is a cool drink of water for your face!
avis.texte: I received this full size product for free in exchange for my honest review. I'm so glad I was selected to review this item as I was in the market for a new setting spray. I haven't been happy with several others I've been using (Urban Decay, Hourglass, Caudalie) so this one came at a perfect time. At first glance, I thought the packaging (the bottle) was cheap and unimpressive. After using the product, I'm in love with the flow of the mist - it is ultra fine and light which seems to help with product absorption. I love it so much, I will re-use the bottle for other products when this one is empty. And once it's empty, I will definitely be purchasing this toning mist again. It leaves my skin feeling very calm, refreshed, hydrated, and dewy. I love using it before serums (like a toner) and after makeup to set and glow. I also use it after working out and as a refresh or touch up on top of makeup later in the day. It has a pleasant floral scent that I find to be mild and lovely. I should add that I recently started using prescription tretinoin. Initially, I was concerned this spray would irritate my already irritated skin. To my surprise, this toning mist actually calmed my skin and did not cause ph balance problems. Lastly, I'm hypersensitive to products that pill, don't layer well, and/or are tacky/sticky on the skin. Nothing will make me return a product faster than a product that doesn't play well with others. This spray serum dries down beautifully. 10/10

The spray is very fine and even, which makes it really easy to use throughout the day. What I like most is the glow it gives. It adds a light, dewy finish without feeling heavy or sticky. My skin feels instantly more hydrated and refreshed. I also enjoy the light scent. it makes the whole experience feel a bit more luxurious!

What an amazing product, it moisturizes your skin , visible reduction in sink tone redness, keeps you fresh all day your skin becomes so breathable and moist all day along, all i can say i use this every single day amazing product

The only issue I had, it didn't leave my face feeling hydrated. I would do I double serum to make sure the product worked well to help my skin stay hydrated.

avis.titre: Little piece of relaxation in a crazy world
avis.texte: This spray serum is a light weight spray that is great now that the temperature is going up. I have used it post face wash in the morning to replace my serum and it is lovely for this as it provides just a tiny bit of serum that allows foundation to glide on smoother and blend out more evenly. As a setting spray it allows the skin finish to look dewy and almost glass like. And the spray is exceptionally fine. No risk of makeup being messed up by particles attacking you face like tiny artillery. However I found this product really shines as a mid day pick me up. I am a 42 year old woman and by mid day my skin can look a little dehydrated and blotchy with or with out makeup. However this spray is a delightful little mood AND skin pick me up. The scent is a gently floral, think true rose scent. As in when you lean it to smell a blooming rose on the bush with the floral of the petals as well as the green of the leaves mixing in the scent, very refreshing. A tiny moment of nature to revitalize your skin and you senses in the middle of the day when your nerves can truly use it. Because of the micro fine mist there is no worry about it messing up your makeup or your desk. With calming ingredients to sooth your skin you are pressing the rest button on your skin to get you through the rest of the day. provided so much more than I was expecting.

avis.titre: I want to order one for my friend too🥰
avis.texte: I'm absolutely thrilled with this serum! It's so convenient that it's in a spray form. After applying it, my skin feels like velvet☺️

I love products that make it easy to stay consistent and are effective. The White Truffle Spray Serum is perfect for students, working professionals, or moms who don't have a ton of time in the evening to apply their skincare regimen. I found the spray to be so much easier than other liquid serums so I have used it consistently for two weeks. I love how hydrating it feels on my skin and it layers well with moisturizer or even sunscreen in the daytime. I love the scent of this serum too & I don't find it too strong. It's light and airy.

Great for anytime. Hydrates and leave skin smooth. Perfect for on the go and easy.

I have used this product for a week. I have not noticed much difference yet. I am still unsure if this is a setting spray or an anti aging spray. I do not care for the smell. Also no matter how much I spray the oil sits at the top of the bottle within seconds of shaking it.

avis.texte: The scent is one of my favorite things about this. Light, fresh, luxurious as a rosie. The mist is super fine and gently that make me never feel heavy or wet. I like using it both before and after makeup for quick refresh, and it gives my skin a nice hydrated glow.
Love to "set my skincare" with this. smells amazing, non oily & leaves a really soft matte finish after SPS.

I have dry skin and have been loving using this new spray after my finishing powders. I typically have very dry skin and patches after applying loose or pressed powder to my face after doing my makeup. This has been a nice setting spray to add back hydration to my skin and make me nice and glowy

I've been gifted the d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum and overall I like it. The mist feels very hydrating and leaves my skin soft after application. It does have a noticeable fragrance at first, but it fades away fairly quickly. I like using it after cleansing and before my daily moisturizer for an extra layer of hydration. I haven't seen a big change in my skin's glow yet, but it keeps my skin feeling moisturized. I would continue using it mainly for the hydration benefits.
I love this product, it is not heavy on my skin when I compare with all other products. It absorbs fast and very effective. My skin feels fresh.

I really enjoyed using the d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum. The mist is super fine and feels refreshing on the skin, and it instantly gives my face a hydrated, dewy glow. I like using it both before and after makeup because it helps my skin look more radiant throughout the day. The formula feels nourishing and calming, the floral scent is pleasant and the texture might feel slightly rich for very oily skin. Overall, it's a great option if you want an easy boost of hydration and that "glass skin" look. ✨

avis.texte: This spray serum is a real lifesaver for my skin. I love how it combines the benefits of a serum and a mist in one product. It feels very lightweight and refreshing on the face, providing immediate hydration and a beautiful, healthy glow. The white truffle extract really makes a difference, leaving my skin feeling soft and nourished.

I had done a chemical peel earlier in the day and was feeling some irritation after applying my night cream and I sprayed the Vital Serum Spray and it calmed the sensitivity in seconds. I'm impressed. It had a light, pleasant scent and also provided some additional hydration.

avis.titre: This product  is really effective and great value for money!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray. It gives my skin a fresh, hydrated, and radiant look without feeling heavy or greasy. The ultra-fine mist absorbs quickly and is great to use before makeup or even sprayed on top to refresh your makeup. My skin feels plumper and smoother all day, and the scent is light and luxurious. If you want hydrated and radiant skin in seconds, this is definitely a must-have! Suitable for aging and dry skin... just a few pumps are enough, and you'll feel the difference in minutes... my skin has a beautiful glow. It helps improve skin tone, reduce dryness, and supports sensitive skin. This product line is truly effective and well worth the money.

I used this product after washing my face and whenever I felt like my skin needed refreshed. I was hoping it would help reduce redness and add hydration, but I didn't feel either benefit. If felt good when spraying it on my face, but I actually felt a bit drier after it settled on my face. It may work better for others, but I didn't have the results I hoped for.

I do find this to calm my skin a bit. Its a nice essence spray overall. Some may find the fragrance irritating, especially since this product is targeted to those with sensitive skin. Not sure if it is worth it at this price point however, I think I prefer my diy spray concoction of rose water, aloe and glycerine but this mister is perfect 👌 It does layer very nicely under and over makeup and I received a travel sized og spray as fwp gift so I can't complain too much!
I love every dalba sprays. I have the yellow bottle as well. It does what it says..calms my skin, lessens the redness on my face and feels great!

I ordered this one over the OG spray because a travel size of it was being gifted with brand purchase anyway so I figured I'd pick another product to try. I picked up this calming apray instead and I'm so glad I did!! I apply a few generous sprays and within minutes there's visible redness relief. It's unreal and applies beautifully over makeup as a refresher too (though I'll probably use the original spray for that purpose). If want a boost of hydration and have redness to conceal, definitely opt for this version of the spray!
